title: Cold-Chain Refill Rescue Desk
oneLiner: A specialty clinic operations desk that flags refrigerated medication refills likely to fail because shipment timing, patient contact, or storage confirmation is drifting out of range.
targetUser: Specialty pharmacy coordinators, infusion clinic staff, and care teams managing temperature-sensitive therapies.
keyUX: Review refill risk by therapy value and shipping window, open one patient case, and see the exact contact or logistics step blocking safe delivery.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop specialty medication operations desk called Cold-Chain Refill Rescue Desk for pharmacy coordinators and infusion clinic staff. It should help teams prevent refrigerated refill failures by combining therapy value, shipping windows, patient contact status, storage confirmation, and intervention ownership in one operational screen. Include an at-risk refill KPI row, a shipping-window queue, a patient contact timeline, a cold-storage confirmation checklist, a route risk map, and an intervention assignment drawer. Design direction: use a field-ops aesthetic with rugged clarity, high-contrast cards, strong section dividers, practical status coding, and mobile-inspired operational cues that make timing and handoffs feel unmistakably actionable.
